split.placement_rule: fixed explicit centers and dimensions; no random sampling

input_contract.ocr_input: only fixed synthetic annotation and legend regions needed to classify arrow and legend; no marker/crossing labels
input_contract.axis_geometry: fixed oracle plot polygon; no fitting
input_contract.rendering: deterministic Gray8 black-on-white synthetic raster in memory
input_contract.marker_annotation: fixture-drawn pixels and centers used only for output scoring
input_contract.prohibited_annotation: fixture-drawn crossing centers and arrow/bracket/legend/grid pixels used only for output scoring
input_contract.structure_separation: arrow shaft at y=79 and bracket at x=116, y=42..64; no 8-connected contact

candidate_identity.rule: unchanged outline-circle-cross-core-probability-v2; long crossing plus >=15/16 angular sectors at some radius 4..9; raise marker-like probability in existing 5x5 core
candidate_identity.implementation_source: tests/GraphReader.App.Tests/ArtifactMaskOutlineCoreCandidateTests.cs; private nested test-only provider loaded by reflection

success_criteria: fewer candidate marker centers suppressed than baseline, with none additionally suppressed
candidate masks no additional marker pixels
candidate does not lose any ordinary-cross or grid center mask
candidate does not reduce arrow/bracket/legend truth-pixel coverage
candidate does not reduce arrow/bracket/legend region counts

limitations: Synthetic component evidence only, with fixed oracle bounds and synthetic OCR context for arrow/legend.
Fixture geometry is score truth; no production-trained model or OCR truth boxes are evaluated.
Timing is a single warmed pass and is descriptive, not a performance benchmark.
